svg.title: WA MCP features
svg.desc: Chat history. Read older messages in context. Search all chats. Find text in any language. Voice transcription. Turn voice notes into text. Text from images. Read photos and screenshots. Document text. Read PDF, Word and Excel files. Download media. Save photos, videos and audio. My day. Track tasks and promises. Chat analytics. Compare volume and reply times. Call history. See who called and when. Human-like sending. Show typing and space out sends. Scheduled messages. Send once or repeat on a schedule. Replies and mentions. Quote, tag and see who reacted. Import old chats. Load a TXT or ZIP chat export. Multiple accounts. Link work and personal numbers. Encrypted storage. Encrypt message text locally. Remote MCP. Connect a client with OAuth. Webhooks and Python SDK. Receive events or script the bridge. Agent connector. Your agent replies by text or voice note. Voice calls in development. Tool result from get_media_text: Bring the éclair recipe.
